title: Closest function satisfying a property
statement: Let $\Omega$ and $\beta$ be finite sets, with $\Omega$ nonempty, and let $f\colon\Omega\to\beta$. Let $P$ be a property of functions from $\Omega$ to $\beta$, and suppose at least one function satisfies $P$. Then the function selected as closest to $f$ among those satisfying $P$ also satisfies $P$, where closeness is measured by the Hamming distance divided by $|\Omega|$.
